items.title: Jack Lesberg interviewed by Monk Rowe, Aspen, Colorado, October 11, 1997
items.q: I went to him and I studied with him for about seven years... He was very, very wonderful and dedicated teacher

ctx.x: I was carried out of there. I was carried out unconscious and I was quite ill there, in the hospital for about a month or so. And I survived it fine and my lungs and everything cleared out and I made my way out of there. And at this time I was already playing the bass, because I’d been playing floor shows there with it and doing all kinds of other things. And I didn’t really start studying the bass formally — I did have this other training, I studied the piano as well early when I was a kid. And when I got to New…
So you worked on the technique of the bass with him. And your jazz playing, was that something you worked on with him or was that more self-taught?
